scientific.integrity: The result is derived directly from the theoretical COCOB recurrence. The balanced alternating sequence makes the betting fraction vanish every even round, which yields an exact reset and a multiplicative wealth recurrence. The average telescopes, and the power-law constant follows from harmonic-number asymptotics plus a convergent cosh product.
limitations: Externally prescribed balanced period-two negative-subgradient input.
Theoretical COCOB Algorithm 1 rather than COCOB-Backprop.
The decimal asymptotic constant is numerical; the infinite-product formula is exact.

source_ids: PMLR/NeurIPS-paper:Training Deep Networks without Learning Rates Through Coin Betting
title: COCOB has an exact balanced-alternation reset law
